quelle: Official German versions of the regulations named per group (EUR-Lex, read via the Publications Office of the EU), checked against the English versions for periods, recipients and delivery times; Annex II of Directive (EU) 2024/1799 as amended by Delegated Directive (EU) 2026/74. As of 13 October 2026.
hinweis: Minimum periods. The requirements apply to manufacturers, importers and authorised representatives, not to retailers; they are product requirements and give buyers no claim of their own. teile_reparateure: parts for professional repairers (fachlich kompetente Reparateure), often restricted to registered repairers; teile_endnutzer: parts for professional repairers and end users. Periods mostly run from the placing on the market of the last unit of a model. lieferzeit_arbeitstage is the maximum delivery time in working days; for smartphones and slate tablets it applies in the first five years of the period, then 10 working days. Empty lists mean no spare parts requirement; null means not evaluated or not applicable (see zeitraum). Parts lists in German (sprache_teile). Not legal advice.
